summary: PJM refiles under FPA section 205 its October 29 amendments to the Reliability Backstop Procurement, responding to the September 29 order on cost allocation, load-serving entity credit and exit responsibility, and conditionally seeks waiver of two shortage rules in Attachment DD.
ask: Accept the RBP amendments effective February 28, 2027 (one record January 29, 2027), issue an order by January 29, 2027, and grant a one-time waiver of Attachment DD sections 16.2 and 16.3.

points.point: The refiling matches the October 29 filing in ER27-330 and changes only its metadata code from compliance to section 205.
points.quote: substantively identical to the October 29, 2026 filing submitted in Docket No. ER27-330-000

points.point: PJM asks for a February 28, 2027 effective date, one record on January 29, 2027, and an order by January 29, 2027.
points.quote: PJM is also requesting that the Commission issue an order on all aspects of this filing no later than January 29, 2027

points.point: PJM seeks conditional waiver of shortage investigation and backstop declaration rules if the 2029/2030 auction clears short.
points.quote: conditionally requests waiver of the requirement in Tariff, Attachment DD, section 16.2

points.point: Electric Distributors will report incremental Large Load growth from the 2026 peak to the 2028/2029 expected peak, replacing the Load Adjustment proxy.
points.quote: rather than relying on Load Adjustment data as a proxy for Large Load growth, PJM is proposing to require Electric Distributors

points.point: PJM allocates the Initial RBP Target by zone share of incremental Large Load growth, net of bilateral offsets, fixed for the 15-year commitment.
points.quote: That allocation to the zone/area will remain fixed throughout the 15-year RBP commitment period.

points.point: PJM cuts the RBP Credit Rate from $1.5 million per MW to 40 percent of net present value, about $686,000 per MW at the cap.
points.quote: the proposed methodology produces an illustrative RBP Credit Rate of approximately $686,000 per MW.

points.point: PJM lengthens LSE collateral notice to at least 75 days and broadens acceptable collateral forms.
points.quote: PJM is proposing that LSEs be provided at least 75 days

points.point: An LSE that withdraws from PJM stays responsible for its remaining RBP Charges, rather than the exiting Transmission Owner.
points.quote: such Load Serving Entity shall be responsible for the remainder of the RBP Charges allocated to it

throughLine.text: Revises the backstop procurement docket's cost allocation, credit and exit terms after FERC's September 29 order, the capacity-adequacy track running beside E-7's report on how PJM will ensure generation for large loads.

figures.label: Illustrative revised RBP credit rate at the $555/MW-day cap
Large Load definition threshold
figures.quote: cumulative peak load of 50 MW or greater at a single electrical site
